paper_metadata.title: An experimental and computational design low-modulus (HfNbTa)1-xTix multiprinciple elemental alloys with super formability for biomedical applications

evidence.quote: In this work, a series of (HfNbTa)1-xTix alloys are designed to investigate the effects of Ti content on the structural and mechanical properties of Bio-MPEAs.
several new low-modulus Bio-MPEAs are designed successfully by combining experimental and computational methods.
